name: Cream Serif Launch
tagline: Warm cream, a chunky serif with one coral italic word, and a product demo that proves a number.
description: Friendly editorial launch style for developer tools and AI products. A big Fraunces question de-blurs onto warm cream with one coral italic word, a soft paper card types a real query and surfaces results with a highlighter sweep, two bars compare before and after while a tilted coral percentage slams in, and the logo lockup ends on an install command.

display.usage: Headlines 76–150px tracking -0.02em; one coral italic word per line; stat 260px

mono.usage: File paths and the install pill, 26–30px

transitions: hard cut between scenes; the next headline rises 30px
headlines and logos resolve from blur (8–26px) instead of fading
textAnimations: query types character by character with a coral caret
result rows rise in sequence, the first gets a coral-tint highlighter sweep
stat slams in tilted -8° from scale 1.7; the old price is struck through

rhythm.notes: Four beats of ~2s: question, demo, proof, lockup.

guide:
- Cream #f3ede2 with a soft centre lightening; cards are #fffaf2 with a warm, low shadow. No pure white or black backgrounds.
- Headlines in Fraunces 800; exactly one word per headline in coral italic (Fraunces 700 italic).
- Show the product doing one real thing (typed query → concrete file paths), not abstract UI.
- Prove it with a before/after bar pair and one big coral percentage; always add a small muted methodology note (n, what was measured).
- Resolve titles and logos from blur; use expo.out for cards and bars.
- End on mark + wordmark, a two-part tagline with the second half in coral italic, and a dark mono install pill.
